Pawtucket Parks Commission Meeting Minutes 
 
 
 
Start Time:    October 13, 2026 – 7:06 pm 
 
Roll Call:  In attendance – Commission members:  Chairman Farrell, Degre-Markley, 
Tierney, Goodwin, Minton, Nese 
 
 
 City Representative: Luke McLaughlin 
         
  
 Excused Absence Commissioner(s):  
 Not present: Commissioner(s): Allen; Imbrascio 
   
Minutes approval –    
1st Motion by Commissioner :  Degre-Markley 
2nd Motion by Commissioner:   Nese  in favor = all    against =  0 
 
 
Public Input:  Per a correspondence received by the Pawtucket City Clerk’s Office on April 1, 2022, 
Mayor Grebien has requested that a Zoom meeting format continue in order for the public to view meetings.  
Committee members are required to be present at these meetings. 
• Sean Tobin – update on Pawtucket Skate Park 
o At this time there is no specific update, he has been directed to connect with Dave Taylor at Pawtucket 
DPW to determine next steps 
 
 
CHAIR UPDATE:  
• n/a 
•  
 
REVIEW OLD BUSINESS  
• Pickleball site recommendation 
o Postponed until next year 
• Parks & Rec Update 
o 10 new trees have been added throughout the City 
o Haunted Tunnel had a better first week than in previous years; foot traffic overall has increased 
from last year; they drew 200-300 attendees per night on the weekends 
o Tennis championships at Slater Park are complete; local Pawtucket resident was this year’s 
Champion 
 
 
NEW BUSINESS 
• City-wide 2026 Annual Report Discussion 
o An informal meeting in November will be held to begin working on the 2026 Annual Report 
• Ideas for 2027 Annual Report 
o Commission will work to create a “wish list” 
• Food Drive Update 
o Three sites have been identified for drop off 
o
OPEN FORUM  
•  
 
 
Motion to adjourn: 
1st Motion by Commissioner Goodwin 
2nd Motion by Commissioner Tierney 
 
 
End time:     8:02 pm
